system.description:
Battle Amp

Draconic Presence. You gain a +1 bonus to your AC and a +10 bonus to your speed.

Dragon Claws. Your [Unarmed Damage] damage type becomes your chosen nature releases damage type.

Wyrm Surge. Non Hijutsu you cast with your chosen nature release gains the Wyrm Surge Keyword as part of their casting. Jutsu with this keyword will always inflict 2 ranks of their associated condition on a failed save or if the attack is a critical hit, unless the jutsu already inflicts the associated condition on a failure. (Earth Release: Shaken, Wind Release: Bleed, Fire Release: Burned, Water Release: Chilled, Lightning Release: Shocked).

Ascended

Superior Release. When you Clash using a jutsu with your chosen nature release keyword, you gain a rank of Mastery to the check.

Seal Consumption. While in Dragons Rage, at the end of each of your turns, remove 1 rank of a Mental Condition you have, and gain 4 Temporary Chakra Points if you do.
system.summary: +1 AC and +10 speed. Dragon Claws take your release's damage type and Wyrm Surge adds 2 ranks of conditions.

rules.text: Dragon Claws: unarmed attacks can use Constitution in place of Strength.

versionSource.description:
Battle Amp

Draconic Presence. You gain a +1 bonus to your AC and a +10 bonus to your speed. This increases to +2 AC and +20 speed at 15th level.

Dragon Claws. Your [Unarmed Damage] damage type becomes your chosen nature releases damage type.

Wyrm Surge. Non Hijutsu you cast with your chosen nature release gains the Wyrm Surge Keyword as part of their casting. Jutsu with this keyword will always inflict 1 rank of their associated condition on a failed save or if the attack is a critical hit, unless the jutsu already inflicts the associated condition on a failure. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at15th level. (Earth Release: Shaken, Wind Release: Bleed, Fire Release: Burned, Water Release: Chilled, Lightning Release: Shocked).

Ascended (7th Level +)

Superior Release. When you Clash using a jutsu with your chosen nature release keyword, you gain a rank of Mastery to the check. This increases to two ranks at 15th level.

Seal Consumption. While in Dragons Rage, at the end of each of your turns, remove 1 rank of a Mental Condition you have, and gain 4 Temporary Chakra Points if you do.

Awakened (15th Level +)

Unbound Savagery. Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast cannot have its damage reduced or altered by hostile jutsu effects or conditions you may have.

Draconic Supremacy. Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast at D-Rank, are cast at no Chakra cost.

rules.text: Dragon Claws: unarmed attacks can use Constitution in place of Strength.
